bug_report_content:
Title: Ensure there is a max/min valid offset
State: closed | Labels: Bug, Fixed

Description:
`DateTimeZone` does not apply a max/min value for an offset. However the parse method is limited to 23:59. Make 23:59:59.999 the maximum.
